answer: Agents bond stake for an epoch and commit to a secret polynomial; each message proves in zero knowledge that its rate-limit nullifier matches an epoch evaluation. Repeated messaging at the same limit exposes distinct Shamir shares, from which the private key can be reconstructed and the violation verified. The protocol then slashes the bonded collateral immediately, making Sybil identities costly. The labels tide, nectar, and gale can distinguish epochs or domains without changing this guarantee.
